workarounds.symptom: dspy 3.4.1: `BetterTogether` raises a `ValueError` that names the student predictors without an LM. 3.4.0 failed later with `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'launch'`. Call
workarounds.workaround: Fix: `BetterTogether` raises a `ValueError` that names the student predictors without an LM. 3.4.0 failed later with `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'launch'`. Call `student.set_lm(lm)`; `dspy.configure(lm=...)` alone is not enough. [#10569](https://github.com/stanfordnlp/dspy/pull/10569). Upstream PR #10569. (Ref: https://github.com/stanfordnlp/dspy/pull/10569)

workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix the 3.4.0 import crash `ImportError: cannot import name 'BaseModel' from partially initialized module 'openai._models'`, which could occur when DSPy lazily imported LiteLLM, for example through `dspy.LM(...).supports_function_calling`. [#10520](https://github.com/stanfordnlp/dspy/pull/10520). Upstream PR #10520. (Ref: https://github.com/stanfordnlp/dspy/pull/10520)
